fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: Use +[label](value) to add inline copyable chips. Placeholders: {company_name}, {company_abbr}, {username}, {password}, {url}, any randomized session field (e.g. {customer_name}, {item_price} — see the Session Data field on a lab instance for the full list), any Seed Record's Label (e.g. {existing_customer}), and {label.fieldname} for a specific field on that Seed Record's created document (e.g. {existing_customer.customer_group}).

fields.label: Navigate to Path
fields.description: Path to open in the lab system (e.g. /app/sales-invoice/new-sales-invoice-1)

fields.label: Navigate Params (JSON)
fields.description: URL params. Placeholders: {company_name}, {company_abbr}, {username}, any randomized session field (e.g. {customer_name}), any Seed Record's Label, and {label.fieldname} for a specific field on that Seed Record's created document.
